create_LMMamba_model: create a language model using LMMamba with LMMambaArgs config and token embeddings
run_LMMamba_forward: run the LMMamba forward pass with token values and optional target tensor for loss
create_StateCache: create a StateCache module to store convolution and state cache buffers for Mamba inference
calculate_flops_per_token: calculate the number of FLOPs per token using get_num_flop_per_token with model parameters
get_activation_checkpointing_ops: get the set of no-recompute ops for activation checkpointing via get_no_recompute_ops
